__inputs.name: DS_INFLUXDB
__inputs.label: InfluxDB
__inputs.description: InfluxDB 2.x datasource, configured with Flux as the query language.

description: SRT stream quality: MOS for video, audio and combined, with the transport and decode telemetry that explains it. Emitted by srtbench.

panels.title: MOS — overall
panels.description: Smoothed combined audio+video MOS. Bands match srtbench's own state machine. UNCALIBRATED by default: trustworthy as a relative indicator, not as an absolute opinion score.

targets.query:
from(bucket: "${bucket}")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "qoe")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field == "mos_overall_smoothed")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.session_id =~ /^${session:regex}$/)
  |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: mean, createEmpty: false)
  |> keep(columns: ["_time", "_value", "_field"])
  |> yield(name: "mos")

from(bucket: "${bucket}")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "qoe")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field == "mos_video")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.session_id =~ /^${session:regex}$/)
  |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: mean, createEmpty: false)
  |> keep(columns: ["_time", "_value", "_field"])
  |> yield(name: "v")

panels.title: Audio MOS
panels.description: Absent, not zero, when the stream carries no audio track.

targets.query:
from(bucket: "${bucket}")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "qoe")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field == "mos_audio")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.session_id =~ /^${session:regex}$/)
  |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: mean, createEmpty: false)
  |> keep(columns: ["_time", "_value", "_field"])
  |> yield(name: "a")

panels.title: Residual video loss
panels.description: Post-ARQ loss that SRT abandoned past its deadline. This is what actually damages the picture, not raw SRT loss, most of which is recovered.

targets.query:
from(bucket: "${bucket}")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "qoe")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field == "effective_loss_pct")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.session_id =~ /^${session:regex}$/)
  |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: mean, createEmpty: false)
  |> keep(columns: ["_time", "_value", "_field"])
  |> yield(name: "l")

from(bucket: "${bucket}")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "srt_transport")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field == "ms_rtt")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.session_id =~ /^${session:regex}$/)
  |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: mean, createEmpty: false)
  |> keep(columns: ["_time", "_value", "_field"])
  |> yield(name: "rtt")

panels.title: Model provenance
panels.description: Whether the coefficient profile has been fitted against ground truth. The shipped defaults are derived estimates, so this reads UNCALIBRATED.

targets.query:
from(bucket: "${bucket}")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "qoe")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field == "calibrated")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.session_id =~ /^${session:regex}$/)
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({r with _value: if r._value then 1 else 0}))
  |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: last, createEmpty: false)
  |> keep(columns: ["_time", "_value", "_field"])
  |> yield(name: "cal")

panels.title: MOS over time — parametric estimate vs VMAF ground truth
panels.description: Lines are the 1 Hz parametric model. Violet markers are the duty-cycled full-reference VMAF mapped onto the MOS scale. The distance between them is the calibration error.

targets.query:
from(bucket: "${bucket}")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "qoe")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field == "mos_overall" or r._field == "mos_video" or r._field == "mos_audio")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.session_id =~ /^${session:regex}$/)
  |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: mean, createEmpty: false)
  |> keep(columns: ["_time", "_value", "_field"])
  |> yield(name: "mos")

from(bucket: "${bucket}")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "srtbench_ref")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field == "mos_vmaf")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.session_id =~ /^${session:regex}$/)
  |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: mean, createEmpty: false)
  |> keep(columns: ["_time", "_value", "_field"])
  |> yield(name: "ref")

panels.title: VMAF (raw)
panels.description: Full-reference video quality, 0-100. Sparse by design: it runs on a duty cycle.

targets.query:
from(bucket: "${bucket}")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "srtbench_ref")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field == "vmaf")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.session_id =~ /^${session:regex}$/)
  |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: mean, createEmpty: false)
  |> keep(columns: ["_time", "_value", "_field"])
  |> yield(name: "vmaf")

panels.title: Effective loss, per stream
panels.description: Damage that reached the decoder, attributed per PID. Video and audio are measured separately because a muxed stream carries roughly 12x more video packets than audio, so one stream-wide figure would misattribute the damage.

targets.query:
from(bucket: "${bucket}")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "qoe")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field == "effective_loss_pct" or r._field == "audio_loss_pct")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.session_id =~ /^${session:regex}$/)
  |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: mean, createEmpty: false)
  |> keep(columns: ["_time", "_value", "_field"])
  |> yield(name: "loss")

panels.title: SRT packet outcomes
panels.description: loss = initially missing, mostly recovered. retrans = recovered by ARQ. drop = abandoned past the deadline, and the only one that damages the picture.

targets.query:
from(bucket: "${bucket}")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "srt_transport")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field == "pkt_recv_loss" or r._field == "pkt_recv_retrans" or r._field == "pkt_recv_drop")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.session_id =~ /^${session:regex}$/)
  |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: mean, createEmpty: false)
  |> keep(columns: ["_time", "_value", "_field"])
  |> yield(name: "pkts")

from(bucket: "${bucket}")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "srt_transport")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field == "ms_rtt")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.session_id =~ /^${session:regex}$/)
  |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: mean, createEmpty: false)
  |> keep(columns: ["_time", "_value", "_field"])
  |> yield(name: "rtt")

panels.title: Bitrate
panels.description: Offered vs received. Under loss the offered figure is reconstructed so the loss is not charged twice, once through a lower bitrate and again through the loss term.

targets.query:
from(bucket: "${bucket}")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "qoe")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field == "br_kbps" or r._field == "br_kbps_received")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.session_id =~ /^${session:regex}$/)
  |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: mean, createEmpty: false)
  |> keep(columns: ["_time", "_value", "_field"])
  |> yield(name: "br")

panels.title: Receiver buffer & latency budget
panels.description: Buffer occupancy against the configured TSBPD budget. As occupancy approaches the budget, packets start being abandoned.

targets.query:
from(bucket: "${bucket}")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "srt_transport")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field == "ms_recv_buf" or r._field == "ms_recv_tsbpd_delay")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.session_id =~ /^${session:regex}$/)
  |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: mean, createEmpty: false)
  |> keep(columns: ["_time", "_value", "_field"])
  |> yield(name: "buf")

panels.title: MPEG-TS continuity errors, per PID
panels.description: Packets the decoder never received, counted exactly and separately per PID. This is the authoritative loss source; SRT drops only correct its magnitude.

targets.query:
from(bucket: "${bucket}")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "ts_stream")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field == "cc_lost_video" or r._field == "cc_lost_audio")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.session_id =~ /^${session:regex}$/)
  |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: mean, createEmpty: false)
  |> keep(columns: ["_time", "_value", "_field"])
  |> yield(name: "cc")

panels.title: Video freezes
panels.description: Freezes dominate perceived quality on a real uplink, and G.1070 has no term for them, so srtbench adds a stall penalty on top.

targets.query:
from(bucket: "${bucket}")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "media_video")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field == "freeze_ms" or r._field == "freeze_ms_max")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.session_id =~ /^${session:regex}$/)
  |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: mean, createEmpty: false)
  |> keep(columns: ["_time", "_value", "_field"])
  |> yield(name: "fz")

panels.title: Decode errors
panels.description: Corroboration only, never part of the loss arithmetic. Errors here with zero measured loss mean srtbench is under-counting, and it raises a floor in response.

targets.query:
from(bucket: "${bucket}")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "media_video")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field == "decode_errors" or r._field == "corrupt_frames")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.session_id =~ /^${session:regex}$/)
  |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: mean, createEmpty: false)
  |> keep(columns: ["_time", "_value", "_field"])
  |> yield(name: "dec")

panels.title: A/V sync drift
panels.description: Deviation from the stream's OWN baseline, not the raw A/V offset. MPEG-TS muxers run video ahead of audio by design (measured: -242 ms on a healthy stream), so penalising the raw offset would fire on every stream. Positive means audio leads. Tolerance is +40/-60 ms.

targets.query:
from(bucket: "${bucket}")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "av_sync")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field == "drift_ms")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.session_id =~ /^${session:regex}$/)
  |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: mean, createEmpty: false)
  |> keep(columns: ["_time", "_value", "_field"])
  |> yield(name: "drift")

panels.title: PCR jitter
panels.description: Spread of arrival time against the program clock. Measured against arrival, not between consecutive PCR values, which are perfect by construction.

targets.query:
from(bucket: "${bucket}")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "ts_stream")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field == "pcr_jitter_ms")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.session_id =~ /^${session:regex}$/)
  |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: mean, createEmpty: false)
  |> keep(columns: ["_time", "_value", "_field"])
  |> yield(name: "pcr")

panels.title: Audio dropouts & silence
panels.description: Silence is DIAGNOSTIC only: a streamer who stops talking is not a defect. It becomes a scored gap only when the frame count corroborates dead audio.

targets.query:
from(bucket: "${bucket}")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "media_audio")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field == "gap_ms" or r._field == "silence_ms")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.session_id =~ /^${session:regex}$/)
  |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: mean, createEmpty: false)
  |> keep(columns: ["_time", "_value", "_field"])
  |> yield(name: "au")

panels.title: Impairment multipliers
panels.description: Each multiplies the MOS headroom, so a score can never fall below 1.0. A value of 1.0 means no penalty.

targets.query:
from(bucket: "${bucket}")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "qoe")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field == "k_freeze" or r._field == "k_sync" or r._field == "k_audio_gap")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.session_id =~ /^${session:regex}$/)
  |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: mean, createEmpty: false)
  |> keep(columns: ["_time", "_value", "_field"])
  |> yield(name: "k")

panels.title: Measurement confidence
panels.description: loss_agreement of 0.3 means the decoder complained while the parser saw no loss. That is the dangerous direction, because it means under-counting.

targets.query:
from(bucket: "${bucket}")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "qoe")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field == "confidence" or r._field == "loss_agreement")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.session_id =~ /^${session:regex}$/)
  |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: mean, createEmpty: false)
  |> keep(columns: ["_time", "_value", "_field"])
  |> yield(name: "conf")

panels.title: Unscored windows
panels.description: Windows srtbench declined to score, and why. An unscoreable window is never written as MOS 1.0; it carries a reason instead.

targets.query:
from(bucket: "${bucket}")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "qoe" and r._field == "reason")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.session_id =~ /^${session:regex}$/)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._value != "")
  |> keep(columns: ["_time", "_value", "session_id"])
  |> rename(columns: {_value: "reason"})
  |> sort(columns: ["_time"], desc: true)
  |> limit(n: 200)

list.name: bucket
list.label: Bucket
